headline: PREDICTIVE DISCOVERY STAKES 12.3% IN AWALE — C$0.85/Share at 10% Premium; Third Major Miner Joins Fortuna and Newmont on 1.71M oz Côte d'Ivoire Copper-Gold Play (TSXV:ARIC)
snippet: Predictive Discovery Limited (ASX: PDI) subscribed for 16,642,352 shares of Awalé Resources (TSXV: ARIC) at C$0.85 per share — a 10% premium to the five-day VWAP ending July 10 — in a C$14.15 million deal giving PDI a 12.3% opening stake and seating it alongside Fortuna and Newmont as the third major mining company strategic investor in Awalé's Odienné Project in Côte d'Ivoire. The Odienné Project hosts an initial inferred resource of 1.71 million ounces gold equivalent across BBM, Charger and Empire; the companies will form a joint technical advisory committee and proceeds fund continued exploration across Awalé's 100%-owned Ivorian properties.

headline: FED SPLIT 9-TO-8 ON RATES AND GOLD PAID FOR IT — 'Until July 14': CPI Miss Sends Spot Back to $4,080; Silver at 69:1 Ratio as Warsh's Committee Eyes July 29 FOMC
snippet: GoldSilver.com's July 14 analysis dissects a Federal Reserve committee fractured 9-to-8 on whether to hike rates further in 2026, with gold and silver absorbing weeks of downside pressure — until the June CPI print landed at 3.5% year-on-year versus 3.8% expected, with headline prices falling 0.4% month-on-month (the sharpest monthly drop since April 2020), sending gold back to $4,080 from a two-week low. Silver, still at $58.55 and sitting 52% below its January 2026 all-time high of $121.62, is trading at a 69.2:1 gold-silver ratio near the top of its 50-year historical range — a structural setup the analysis frames as uniquely attractive ahead of the decisive July 29 FOMC meeting.

headline: ISS GREENLIGHTS $18.5B CANADIAN GOLD GIANT — Equinox-Orla Vote July 22, Proxy Deadline July 20; 1M+ oz Pro Forma Producer, $1.4B Free Cash Flow Target (TSX:EQX / TSX:ORLA)
snippet: Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) and Glass Lewis both recommended that Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) shareholders vote FOR the July 22 special meeting resolution to issue up to 421.8 million shares to complete its business combination with Orla Mining (TSX: ORLA), with Canadian and Mexican competition clearances already in hand. The combined entity would rank as the second-largest gold producer in Canada, targeting pro forma 2026 production of more than one million ounces across operations in Canada, the U.S., Nicaragua and Mexico, plus approximately $1.4 billion in free cash flow and liquidity; former Orla shareholders would retain approximately 33% of the combined group.

headline: ARTEMIS BLACKWATER POSTS QUARTERLY RECORD — 74,063 oz Gold, Up 20% QoQ; 92.2% Recovery All-Time High; 135,986 oz YTD on Track for 265K–290K oz Full-Year Guidance (TSXV:ARTG)
snippet: Artemis Gold Inc. (TSXV: ARTG) reported that its Blackwater Mine in British Columbia produced a quarterly record 74,063 ounces of gold in Q2 2026 — a 20% increase from Q1 — with feed grades averaging 1.86 g/t gold and gold recoveries reaching an all-time high of 92.2% through continued process optimisation. Year-to-date production stands at 135,986 ounces with full-year guidance of 265,000–290,000 ounces firmly on track; Phase 2 expansion debottlenecking work continues across crushing, grinding, and leach circuits at the central British Columbia mine, with full Q2 financial results due August 6, 2026.

headline: MARTINIERE'S BUG LAKE FIRES: 18.3 g/t Au OVER 1.4m, 4.34 g/t OVER 10m — Phase 2 Stalled by Quebec Forest Fires; 2,000m × 800m Shear Zone Still Wide Open (TSX:WM)
snippet: Wallbridge Mining (TSX: WM) released Phase 1 drill results from the final four holes in the Bug Lake deformation corridor at the Martiniere gold project in Quebec's Abitibi region — highlights include 18.30 g/t Au over 1.4 metres, 4.34 g/t Au over 10.0 metres, and 9.95 g/t Au over 3.0 metres, with all six Phase 1 holes intersecting multiple gold-bearing shear structures. The mineralized footprint now spans 2,000 metres along strike, 800 metres wide and at least 800 metres deep and remains open in several directions; the Phase 2 campaign originally scheduled for early July has been temporarily postponed due to nearby forest fires — adding a logistical twist to what was shaping up as an active summer program.

headline: SCORPIO'S GOLDWEDGE: 97.99m AT 2.05 g/t Au From 64m — 18 Step-Outs Break Beyond Resource Model at Manhattan; Silver Now Added for Future Multi-Element Estimate (TSXV:SGN)
snippet: Scorpio Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGN) released 18-hole Phase 2 step-out assays at the Goldwedge target in Manhattan, Nevada, headlined by hole 26MN-090 returning 97.99 metres at 2.05 g/t gold from 64.16 metres depth — including a 2.35-metre interval at 16.47 g/t — extending mineralization significantly beyond the current resource model at shallow, bulk-minable depths. Silver assays are now being incorporated from the program, with management indicating the data set will support a future multi-element resource estimate at a historically productive Nevada gold-silver district; results from additional holes in the batch add continuity between Goldwedge and the Black Mammoth step-out zones.

headline: KUTCHO FIRES FIRST MAJOR DRILL IN 15 YEARS — 2 Rigs, 11 Holes at Hamburger, Gap and Esso West VMS Conductors; NW BC Copper-Zinc Feasibility Project Pursues Long-Awaited Resource Growth (TSXV:KC)
snippet: Kutcho Copper Corp. (TSXV: KC) has commenced drilling at its high-grade copper-zinc VMS feasibility project in northwest British Columbia — 11 planned holes across three targets (Hamburger, Gap and Esso West) that have not seen drill testing in more than 15 years, despite representing ZTEM conductivity highs supported by geological, magnetic and seismic data to 850-metre depth. Two rigs are active and all holes will be accompanied by downhole EM surveys to precisely vector in on conductor orientation; the program tests whether these targets represent additional VMS lenses within the same Kutcho time horizon that hosts the existing resource — approximately 63.5 million tonnes of 1.57% copper equivalent probable reserves.

headline: UEC'S TEXAS ISR NOW PRODUCING — Burke Hollow Delivers 32,195 lbs U₃O₈ at $54.61/lb in First Full Quarter; Wellfield Expansion Targets 12M lbs/yr Platform (NYSE:UEC)
snippet: Uranium Energy Corp (NYSE: UEC) is ramping production at its Burke Hollow in-situ recovery project in South Texas — the world's newest ISR uranium mine and the first new U.S. ISR operation in over a decade — following a Q2 output of 32,195 pounds of uranium concentrate at a cash cost of $54.61 per pound. New header houses are scheduled to come online through the remainder of fiscal 2026 to accelerate throughput, and UEC is simultaneously expanding wellfields at its Wyoming hub; the combined Wyoming-South Texas hub-and-spoke ISR platform represents 12 million pounds per year of nameplate capacity, positioning UEC as the operator of the largest domestic uranium production footprint in the United States.

headline: CORE LITHIUM SWINGS PICKS AT FINNISS AGAIN — Open Pit Mining Commenced, US$274M Underground Contract Signed; First Spodumene Concentrate Target September Quarter 2026 (ASX:CXO)
snippet: Core Lithium Ltd. (ASX: CXO) has restarted physical mining at the Grants open pit within its Finniss Lithium Project in Australia's Northern Territory, backed by a fully-funded $300+ million restart package, and simultaneously awarded a US$274 million underground development contract to Develop Global for the BP33 decline — with underground mobilisation targeted in June and works commencing in July 2026. First spodumene concentrate production is targeted for the September 2026 quarter, with first exports in December 2026 and ramp to nameplate capacity of 1.2Mtpa SC6 equivalent by mid-2028; the restart brings back one of Australia's larger hard-rock lithium operations as spodumene prices recover toward incentive levels.

headline: BCM DRILLS DEEPEST HOLE EVER AT THOMPSON KNOLLS — TK16 Hits Skarn at 621m to 1,156m Depth; TK17 + TK18 Passed 900m as Utah Cu-Au-Ag-Mo Porphyry System Expands (TSXV:B)
snippet: BCM Resources Corp. (TSXV: B) has advanced its fully funded 2026 drill campaign at the Thompson Knolls porphyry-skarn Cu-Au-Ag-Mo discovery in Utah, completing a project-record hole TK16 to 1,269 metres — with extensive pyroxene-diopside skarn and associated sulfide mineralization intersected from 621 to 1,156 metres — followed by the completion of holes TK17 (896m) and TK18 (917m). The project is located adjacent to Highway 50 in southwestern Utah, with prior hole TK8 returning a 155.4-metre composite grading 0.66% Cu, 0.12 g/t Au and 7.4 g/t Ag; the 2026 campaign uses RC drilling through the fanglomerate cover followed by diamond core to target the porphyry-skarn contact at depth.

headline: SAME GOLD RALLY, 79% MORE UPSIDE IN GDX — Miners Outpaced Bullion by That Margin Over Past Year; GDXJ's 55% vs. IAU's 23% Makes the Leverage Case Despite 2026 YTD Compression
snippet: A 24/7 Wall St. analysis published July 13 quantifies the equity alpha in the current gold cycle: over the trailing twelve months, the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) returned approximately 49.8% while the iShares Gold Trust (IAU) returned 22.97% — meaning mining stocks delivered roughly 79% more upside from the same underlying commodity. GDXJ edged GDX at 55.16% one-year return as junior and mid-tier miners captured the highest operating leverage; the piece argues that even with GDX down 11-14% year-to-date in 2026, the long-term equity leverage thesis remains structurally intact given near-record earnings at $4,000+ gold prices and historically compressed mining equity multiples.

headline: WESDOME Q2: 43,823 oz GOLD, KIENA UP 28% YoY — Eagle River Mill Throughput Jumps 49%; First Presqu'île Stope Enters Production Week of July 13, Adding Third High-Grade Zone (TSX:WDO)
snippet: Wesdome Gold Mines Ltd. (TSX: WDO) reported Q2 2026 production of 43,823 ounces — up 2% year-over-year — and confirmed the company remains on track for full-year consolidated guidance of 180,000–205,000 ounces, with Kiena mine output surging 28% year-over-year to 22,026 ounces and Eagle River mill throughput rising 49% versus Q2 2025. The company flagged a key operational catalyst for the week of July 13: the first Presqu'île stope entering production at Kiena, adding a third active high-grade mining zone to the Quebec mine's portfolio and providing a meaningful H2 2026 output catalyst; full Q2 financial results are due August 13.
